notes: Sourced from Extron's own datasheet (doc 5654-D13, "Extron IPCP Pro 550 IP Link Pro Control Processor - Specifications"), fetched via an authorized-reseller mirror (extron.com itself blocks automated fetches with bot defense) and cross-checked against Extron search-result excerpts and reseller listings. This is the base/retired IPCP Pro 550 (not the newer "550 xi" variant, which has more memory/CPU but the same physical I/O). All serial, Flex I/O, IR/serial, relay, eBUS, and switched-DC ports use 3.5mm captive screw (Euroblock-style) terminal blocks per Extron's spec sheet; grouped multi-port connectors (e.g. 2 IR/serial ports per 4-pole connector, 2 relays per 4-pole connector) were split into logical port pairs since the physical connector serves 2 logical signals each. No grade applies to any Euroblock-terminated port (serial/control/power), consistent with the grading rules. Ethernet is confirmed 10/100/1000Base-T (eth-1g). No USB port exists on this model per the spec sheet (absent from Extron's own port list). The AC inlet connector type (IEC vs. captcaptive cord) was not itemized as a discrete port in the official spec sheet's connector tables; IEC C14 is inferred with medium confidence based on Extron's standard "Everlast" internal-supply enclosure used across the IPCP Pro 350/250/550 family, which use IEC inlets — flagged here as the one inferred/unconfirmed data point. Enclosure: 1U high, half-rack-wide (8.7"W), metal, optional 1U rack shelf accessory for full-rack mounting.
